capabilities.name: tag.context.overview
capabilities.use: Confirm the nexus, the caller's role and that TAG is invited.

capabilities.name: tag.policy.reporting.read
capabilities.use: Approved framework, policies, statement mapping, materiality and language.

capabilities.name: tag.ledger.trial_balance.read
capabilities.use: Adjusted trial balance, opening balances and prior-period trial balance.

capabilities.name: tag.ledger.chart_of_accounts.read
capabilities.use: Account list and types to build or check the mapping.

capabilities.name: tag.ledger.transactions.read
capabilities.use: Adjustment detail and movement schedules from subledgers.

capabilities.name: tag.documents.render
capabilities.use: XLSX and PDF renderings of report.json.

capabilities.name: tag.evidence.attach
capabilities.use: Record the input hash, outputs and source identifiers against the run.

capabilities.name: tag.review.request
capabilities.use: Route the draft package to the organization's reviewer.

inputs.name: reporting framework (ASPE or IFRS), approved policies, mapping, materiality, language
inputs.source: tag.policy.reporting.read, or approved documents the user supplies

inputs.name: adjusted trial balance with snapshot identity and completeness flag
inputs.source: tag.ledger.trial_balance.read, or a ledger export the user supplies

inputs.name: post-closing opening balances
inputs.source: tag.ledger.trial_balance.read for the prior period end

inputs.name: movement schedules (fixed assets, debt, equity, dividends, non-cash), FX effect on cash, intercompany confirmations
inputs.source: tag.ledger.transactions.read or schedules the user supplies

outputs.name: report.json
outputs.description: Statements, checks, exceptions, notes draft and traceability.

outputs.name: statements.md
outputs.description: Package rendered in the selected language.

outputs.name: income_statement.csv, balance_sheet.csv, cash_flow_statement.csv, equity_statement.csv, exceptions.csv, traceability.csv

conditions: Before any use outside the organization's finance function.
Whenever the report status is blocked or any error exception is open.
When a judgement is not settled by the approved policies.
Assurance (audit, review, compilation) needs the appropriate professional engagement; this draft is not one.
